FOREVVORD 


This Indian Standard (First Revision) vvas adopted by the Bureau of Indian Standards, after the draft finalized by 
the Sports Goods Sectional Committee had been approved by the Production and General Engineering Division 
Council, 


Clubs are used by athletes and gymnasts for physical training. These are also employed for regular body-building 
by other cross-sections of society. The results being dependent to a large extent on the equipment available, 
formulation of a standard vvas considered very essential. 


This standard vvas first published in 1968. VVhile preparing this standard, considerable assistance had been derived 
from the follovving: 


a) DIN 7912: 1960 Indian clubs. Deutscher Normenausschuss. 
b) Drg No. IND/GS/MED/393(a) Clubs, Indian. GIGS, Ministry of Defence, 
Government of India.

the rounded off value should be the same as that of the specified value in this standard.

1SCOPE 


This standard covers the requirements for Indian 
clubs used for physical training.

3 МАТЕКІДІ, 


Indian clubs shall be manufactured from reasonably 
straight-grained and vvell-seasoned vvood. Moisture 
content shall not exceed 12 percent (see 15 1708 
(Part 1)). The vvood shall be free from any kind of 
decay, insect attack, sapvvood, centre heart (pith) 
knots, splits, vvarping, or any other defect vvhich is 
likely to impair its durability. The recommended

5 VVORKMANSHIP AND FINISH 


5.1 The clubs shall be turned from vvood іп such a 
vvay that the centre of gravity of the club lies in the 
lovver portion. 


5.2 The surface obtained shall be smooth and free 
from pits and other imperfections. The edges shall 
be rounded. 


5.3 Before the clubs are vamished, these shall be 
treated by dipping either in a 10 percent (by vveight) 
solution of copper naphthenate (see IS : 1078) in 
vvhite spirit for 10 seconds or in copper naphthenate 
dispersed in aqueous ammonia for 1 minute and 
allovved to dry thoroughly. Thereafter, the clubs 
shall be given tvvo coats of varnish, shellac (see IS : 
347). The second coat shall be applied after the first 
has dried thoroughly. 


6 PACKING AND MARKING 
6.1 Packing 


Clubs shall be packed as agreed to betvveen the 
purchaser and the supplier. 


6.2 Marking 


6.2.1 Each club shall be marked vvith the follovving 
information: 


a) carry the manufacturer”s name or dentification 
mark, and 
b) Month and year of manufacturing. 


6.2.2 BIS Certification Marking 


The product(s) conforming to the requirements of 
this standard may be certified as per the conformity 
assessment schemes under the provisions of the 
Bureau of İndian Standards Act, 2016 and the Rules 
and Regulations framed thereunder, and the 
product(s) may be marked vvith the standard mark.
